Below is the proposed package for approval. Can comp/HR confirm if this fits the SWE II band for SF/remote CA? If yes, I will route to Finance for the headcount move and then to Jason for the offer call.

Candidate: Jason O'Neill (contractor)
Current start at Redwood (contractor): 2025-05-05
Proposed FTE title: Software Engineer II, Infra
Manager: Laura Bennett
Proposed start (FTE): 2026-03-15
Location: Remote (PST) — candidate West Coast
Headcount: convert contractor slot -> FTE (headcount currently in infra team pool)

Comp proposal (initial):
- Base salary: $150,000
- Sign-on (one-time conversion bonus): $7,000
- Equity: 0.04% (RSU, 4-year vest, 1yr cliff)
- Target total comp (first year, estimate): ~$160k + equity

Rationale/notes:
- Jason has been instrumental in the KV cache migration and onboarded two new ICs while contracting.
- Low ramp risk — already in team; minimal onboarding time.
- Contractor billing through ContractorOps will stop on acceptance date; we have slot capacity in FY26 infra headcount.

Attachments: Jason_ONeill_resume.pdf; conversion_package_breakdown.xlsx (breakdown by comp band, budget impact, and payroll timing).

Next steps requested: Comp band confirmation (Michael) and formal HR approval (Tessa). If approved, I'll open a Finance headcount movement ticket and share the offer doc for signatures.

Thanks Marissa — quick read-through. High level: package looks reasonable but two clarifying items before HR sign-off:

1) Band/location: The SWE II SF remote CA band midpoint is $155k (see band table) and midpoint range is 135–175k. Given Jason's tenure with us as a contractor and the cost savings compared to renewing the contractor, $150k is within range but on the lower side. Are you prioritizing budget or speed here?
2) Equity: 0.04% is fine for IC II but confirm he hasn't previously been granted equity for contractor work (he hasn't to my knowledge).

If you want to be aggressive for retention, I would suggest $155k base + $5k sign-on. If we're budget constrained, $145–150k + $7k sign-on works too.

I'm attaching the compensation band doc for HR and Finance reference: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-band-table.

Please confirm location (CA vs WA) — that drives payroll taxes. Once confirmed, I can mark this as prelim-approved pending final HR checkbox (offer letter, background check).

- Michael
Compensation & People Ops
Redwood Inference
